look_here_first: Recognize opposite rough, toothed leaves and dense clusters of small tubular flowers whose colors may change; check black fleshy drupes and branching prickles.
photo_note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
identification_caution: Introduced Lantana camara comparative card; never label it a local native or recommend it as a restoration planting. Photo taken from a cultivated specimen, not proof of wild-type origin.
